d:
Chhath mahaparv ka jikr ho aur chhath ke paranprik giton ki bat na ho, aisa sanbhav nahin hai. chhath puja aur lokgiton ka rishta behad gahra hai. char dinon tak chalne vale is mahaparv ke dauran gharon se lekar ghaton tak chhath giton ki gunj sunaee deti hai. in giton men jahan bhagvan sury aur chhathi maeeya ke prati atut aastha aur samarpan jhalakta hai, vahin parivarik rishton, lok paranpraon, samajik sarokaron aur badalte samay ki tasvir bhi dikhaee deti hai.
